title: BusterX: MLLM-Powered AI-Generated Video Forgery Detection and Explanation

bias_targets.methodology: Enforcing balanced gender representation (including non-binary identities) in synthetic video generation prompts and conducting expert manual audits to identify and discard videos with harmful demographic stereotypes.
Applying strict semantic constraints during the seed generation stage to ensure synthetic videos feature normally distributed age groups.
Guaranteeing geographically balanced ethnicities across human-centric contexts in video prompts and using a manual fairness audit to filter out racial stereotypes.
Combating intersectional bias by uniformly sampling across combined demographic attributes to explicitly avoid the over-representation of specific demographics in certain occupational settings.
Instructing human annotators during a strict fairness audit to identify and discard generated video clips that exhibit cultural misrepresentations or stereotypes.
